The Jaipur Bench of Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (“ITAT”) vide order dated 18 March 2025 has remanded the matter back to the file of assessing officer to decide afresh. Consequenty, the addition made during the assessment proceedings and upheld by the CIT(A) due to non appearance does not stand. Hence, by giving effect to the ITAT’s order the demand be kindly removed from the portal. Remand back proceedings have been initiated separately. Thus, the demand is not payable.

Respected your honors, this is with reference to the appeal filed by
the Appellant and submissions filed on 18 July 2025, 11 August
2025 and 23 August 2025 (High-Pitched Assessment Committee
order). In this appeal, the demand is of Rs 20,48,10,450 (Rs 20.48
crores) and therefore it is requested to kindly grant a hearing
through Video Conferencing so as to explain the matter and issue
involved and the submissions filed. We will be grateful to you for
your quick action in this matter. Thanking you. Best regard, A/R of
the Appellant, Kalani & Co LLP, Jaipur CA Yogesh Parwal
